BrochureContent.Content:
Pembrokestown House is one of Ireland’s finest private estates — an extraordinary Regency residence set within approximately 10.6 acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, where historic grandeur meets contemporary luxury in spectacular fashion and just a twenty minute drive from the soon to be expanded Waterford Airport.

Approached via a sweeping tree-lined avenue and secured behind electric gates, the estate immediately conveys a sense of arrival. Meticulously restored and reimagined, Pembrokestown House now offers an exceptional standard of  accommodation while remaining faithful to the architectural integrity and character of its Regency origins.

The estate comprises an exclusive collection of three residences totalling 938 sq. m./10,096 sq. ft.: the magnificent main house, a beautifully converted Coach House, and a meticulously rebuilt Stables residence. Together they create a private family compound of remarkable flexibility, ideal for multigenerational living, guest accommodation, staff quarters, or luxury hospitality use (subject to planning).

The restoration programme has been undertaken with exceptional attention to detail, seamlessly integrating period craftsmanship with modern comforts. Elegant reception rooms, exquisite architectural detailing, and beautifully proportioned interiors combine to create a residence of rare quality and distinction.

Outside, the estate is equally impressive. Approximately seven acres of rolling lawns provide a stunning setting, complemented by a spectacular sunken courtyard, heated swimming pool, vitality pool, extensive entertaining terraces, and mature gardens that offer complete privacy and tranquillity. The grounds also provide scope for paddocks and equestrian pursuits, further enhancing the lifestyle appeal.

Pembrokestown House is far more than a home — it is a private country estate of exceptional beauty, heritage, and scale, offering a lifestyle rarely available on the Irish market.

More about the location...

Enjoying a peaceful setting in Gaulstown, Buttlerstown, Pembrokestown House offers the perfect balance of rural seclusion and accessibility. Waterford City is approximately 20 minutes away, as is Waterford Airport will further enhance national and international connectivity.

The surrounding area is renowned for its natural beauty and outdoor pursuits. The beaches of Tramore and Dunmore East are within easy reach, offering sailing, swimming, surfing, and coastal walks. Championship golf courses including Faithlegg and Waterford Castle are nearby, while the acclaimed Waterford Greenway provides over 46km of scenic cycling and walking trails through some of Ireland’s most beautiful countryside.

Excellent road connections via the N25 provide convenient access to Cork, Wexford, Kilkenny, and Dublin, making Pembrokestown House an ideal country retreat without compromising on accessibility.

A landmark Irish estate where architectural heritage, privacy, and luxury living come together in an beautiful setting.

Elegant Regency-style residence dating from the late 18th / early 19th century.
Extensively and sensitively restored to preserve original period character.
Set within almost 11 acres of landscaped grounds with potential paddocks.
Impressive tree-lined entrance avenue offering exceptional privacy.
Eight-bedroom accommodation across three residential units.
Original fireplaces, cornicing, ceiling roses and shutters retained throughout.
Stunning Georgian-style entrance with fanlight and side lights.
Barrel-vaulted corridors running the width of the home.
Grand drawing room with black marble mantelpiece and high ceilings.
Designer country-style kitchen with direct terrace access.
South-facing terraces overlooking the gardens and courtyard.
Converted Coach House with striking glazed architectural design.
Additional guest accommodation within the restored stables.
Heated 25-metre swimming pool and separate relaxation/vitality pool.
Beautiful sunken courtyard ideal for entertaining.
Dedicated gym space within the Coach House conversion.
Mature manicured gardens with raised planting areas and barbecue space.
Solar panels installed on the main residence.
Private chemical-free water supply purified using UV filtration.
Located close to Waterford City and the beaches of Tramore.
20 minute drive from the soon to be expanded Waterford airport.
Sophisticated CCTV, security and fire alarm systems.
Backup generator power system.
